name: Screen/Server Detail — Capture — Start capture
context: Start Capture for remote-lab. Values illustrate that selected site: defaults and ceilings come from its capability response, independently of central settings.

qzcst.content: Records raw network traffic on this server's advertised ports (or a custom filter) for later download.

children.content: Optional. Use pcap-filter syntax (e.g. "tcp port 8080", "host 192.168.1.5"). Leave blank to capture only on this server's game ports.
How long the capture runs before auto-stopping. Range 1–3600 seconds.
Maximum file size: 5 GB. Capture stops when reached.
How long the capture is retained before auto-delete. Maximum: 24h.
